description: Khao kha mu (Thai script: ข้าวขาหมู) is steamed rice served with sliced pork trotter which has been simmered in soy sauce and five spice powder. It is always served with a sweet spicy dipping sauce on the side. Often a clear broth is provided on the side as well, as are fresh bird's eye chillies and cloves of raw garlic.
